summary: Agree Realty Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing its weighted-average common shares outstanding for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing provides dilution calculations from unvested restricted shares, share-based compensation, ATM forward equity offerings, and OP units. No special situation event—such as a merger, tender, activist campaign, or restructuring—is announced. The disclosure is a routine financial update with no deal terms or corporate action.
